# Conformance fixtures

These deterministic synthetic `.nx` files are generated by `tests/conformance/build_fixtures.py`. That builder supports only the fixed cases below; it is not a source-tree packer or production Rust implementation. Generated binaries contain no Nintendo proprietary data or assets. `fixture_index.json` records each file's size, SHA-256, purpose, and expected outcome.

Run `python tests/conformance/build_fixtures.py` to regenerate, then `python tests/conformance/validate_fixtures.py` to validate. The validator independently parses the binary records and checks the fixture index. Python 3.14+ supplies the standard-library Zstandard module used for the compressed-block fixture.

| Fixture | Expected | Exact characteristic |
|---|---|---|
| `minimal_valid.nx` | Accept | One application, one program, one base snapshot, one empty root directory; no files, media, or data blocks. |
| `raw_only.nx` | Accept | One 4-byte RAW file block; no Zstandard blocks. |
| `nested_vfs.nx` | Accept | Root contains a child directory and a file; the child directory contains a second file. |
| `zstd_single.nx` | Accept | One 4096-byte repeated-byte file in one 19-byte independent Zstandard frame; one block, one CRC-32C slice row, and a nonzero 32-byte snapshot Build ID. |
| `multi_block_file.nx` | Accept | One 65,537-byte file with 64 KiB chunks: two RAW blocks of 65,536 and 1 byte. |
| `mixed_raw_zstd.nx` | Accept | One 512 KiB file with 256 KiB chunks; the first block is RAW and the second is one independent Zstandard frame. |
| `shared_blocks.nx` | Accept | Two files in one snapshot reference the same 4-byte block ID. |
| `shared_with_orphan_block.nx` | Accept | Two files share physical block 0; physical block 1 is intentionally unreferenced and still subject to full integrity verification. |
| `shared_snapshots.nx` | Accept | Two complete versioned snapshot roots reuse the same file/block records but have distinct version-scoped identities. |
| `deleted_between_versions.nx` | Accept | Version 1 contains `keep.bin` and `remove.bin`; version 2 contains only `keep.bin`. Deletion is absence from the second complete tree. |
| `multiple_programs.nx` | Accept | One application has two distinct programs and one complete snapshot each. |
| `metadata_snapshot_tie.nx` | Accept | Two programs tie on version; selected metadata points to snapshot 1, while a required history extension preserves snapshot 0's exact title, publisher, two locales, original shared PNG references, and NACP association. |
| `localized_metadata_icons.nx` | Accept | Default and Japanese localized title/icon references; two independent synthetic 1×1 PNG media payloads. |
| `switch2_localized_icons.nx` | Accept | Synthetic Switch 2 catalog, French and Japanese titles, one original PNG icon shared by both locales. This fixture validates structure only and is not native game metadata. |
| `jpeg_icon.nx` | Accept | A synthetic 1×1 JPEG icon is loaded on demand and checked against its exact source SHA-256. |
| `same_application_id_cross_platform.nx` | Accept | Same numeric Application ID on two platforms is valid; uniqueness is the `(platform, application_id)` pair. |
| `dlc_without_program.nx` | Accept | Complete DLC snapshot uses the absent program index; no executable Program ID is fabricated. |
| `dlc_with_program.nx` | Accept | A DLC can reference a real, source-provided executable Program ID. |
| `distinct_dlc_same_tree.nx` | Accept | Two DLCs with identical trees and versions but distinct content IDs have distinct snapshot identities. |
| `dlc_only_application.nx` | Accept | A DLC-only application has zero Program rows and an absent `first_program_index`; its DLC snapshot is still a complete tree. |
| `empty_files.nx` | Accept | One zero-byte file, zero block references, and SHA-256 of empty bytes. |
| `corrupted_manifest.nx` | Reject | One Manifest byte changed without updating `manifest_sha256`. |
| `corrupted_integrity_table.nx` | Reject | Integrity-table byte changed without updating `index_sha256`. |
| `corrupted_hot_index.nx` | Reject | Block descriptor byte changed without updating `index_sha256`. |
| `corrupted_index_sha256.nx` | Reject | Header `index_sha256` changed while the header CRC is recalculated. |
| `corrupted_block_payload.nx` | Reject full verify | RAW payload byte changed while the block index and integrity table remain valid. |
| `corrupted_orphan_block.nx` | Reject full verify | The unreferenced second physical block is corrupted; full verification must check it even though two files share block 0. |
| `invalid_metadata_snapshot.nx` | Reject | Application display metadata source points outside its snapshot range; Catalog digest and header CRC are recalculated. |
| `invalid_empty_metadata_source.nx` | Reject | In-range metadata source pointer exists without native metadata. |
| `invalid_history_media_type.nx` | Reject | Historical icon reference targets an NACP Media record; Catalog digest and header CRC are recalculated. |
| `invalid_present_empty_title.nx` | Reject | A present title reference with zero length is invalid; Catalog digest and header CRC are recalculated. |
| `invalid_language_subtag.nx` | Reject | Localized language `j-` contains an empty BCP 47 subtag; Catalog digest and header CRC are recalculated. |
| `invalid_shared_media_types.nx` | Reject | The same media index cannot be both an icon and a program NPDM; hashes are recalculated. |
| `duplicate_snapshot_identity.nx` | Reject | Two snapshots with distinct content IDs cannot reuse one identity; hashes are recalculated. |
| `invalid_snapshot_program.nx` | Reject | Base snapshot has no executable program association; Catalog digest and header CRC are recalculated. |
| `invalid_build_id_flag.nx` | Reject | Build ID presence flag disagrees with its 32-byte value; Catalog digest and header CRC are recalculated. |
| `invalid_program_application.nx` | Reject | Program references an application index outside the Catalog; Catalog digest and header CRC are recalculated. |
| `duplicate_application_key.nx` | Reject | Two records share both platform and Application ID; Catalog digest and header CRC are recalculated. |
| `invalid_metadata_snapshot_owner.nx` | Reject | Application metadata points into another application's snapshot range; Catalog digest and header CRC are recalculated. |
| `invalid_program_snapshot_range.nx` | Reject | Program snapshot range includes a different program's snapshot; Catalog digest and header CRC are recalculated. |
| `invalid_offsets.nx` | Reject | Catalog offset points beyond the declared archive; header CRC is recalculated. |
| `truncated_archive.nx` | Reject | Final byte removed; declared archive size exceeds the physical length. |
| `invalid_path.nx` | Reject | Path component is `../escape`; Manifest hash and header CRC are recalculated so path validation is reached. |
| `cyclic_directory.nx` | Reject | A child directory entry points back to the snapshot root; Manifest digest and header CRC are recalculated. |
| `repeated_directory.nx` | Reject | Two paths in one snapshot reach the same directory record; hashes are recalculated. |
| `repeated_file.nx` | Reject | Two paths in one snapshot reach the same File record, with unchanged logical size and identity; hashes are recalculated. |
| `unknown_mandatory_feature.nx` | Reject | Unknown required header feature bit is set; header CRC is recalculated. |
| `appended_generation.nx` | Accept | In-place edit: header slot B holds generation 1, whose tail follows a stale tail and arbitrary free bytes; slot A (generation 0) stays valid. |
| `appended_generation_2.nx` | Accept | Two in-place edits: generation 2 in slot A, generation 1 in slot B. |
| `interrupted_commit.nx` | Accept | Torn generation-1 slot (bad CRC-32C) falls back to generation 0; 100 residue bytes after `archive_size` are ignored. |
| `damaged_slot_a.nx` | Accept | Slot A magic damaged; the identical slot B is used. |
| `slot_generation_conflict.nx` | Reject | Both slots valid with generation 0 but different bytes. |
| `damaged_both_slots.nx` | Reject | Neither header slot is valid. |
| `bad_header_page_padding_1.nx` | Accept | One page has nonzero padding. The other page remains valid. |
| `bad_header_page_padding_2.nx` | Reject | Both pages have nonzero padding despite valid header CRCs. |
| `legacy_shared_header_page.nx` | Reject | The old layout places both headers in the first page and lacks the required layout bit. |
| `lost_header_page_0.nx` | Accept | Complete loss of page A leaves generation 1 in page B readable. |
| `lost_header_page_1.nx` | Accept | Complete loss of page B leaves generation 2 in page A readable. |
| `max_generation.nx` | Accept | Both pages hold the maximum generation. A further append is rejected rather than wrapping. |
| `truncated_header_area.nx` | Reject | The file ends one byte before the second page is complete. |
| `unknown_optional_header_feature.nx` | Reject | A reserved optional header bit is set in both CRC-valid headers. |

The validator independently declares each record layout and offset, checks exact record widths, all table ranges, header/Catalog/Manifest/index hashes, block sizes, frame decompression, file contents, tree and metadata relationships, expected rejection stage, and generated-file hashes. The fixture builder does not share parsing code or binary-layout constants with the validator.

The C++ regression tests also inject page read errors.
